Scope of Work for Roadway Improvements at Charles Street
Ardurra is pleased to present this Scope of Work fordesign of roadway improvements at Charles Street in
Cheyenne, Wyoming.
Project Understanding:
Planned development of a parcel south of Charles Street has prompted a need for the improvement ofthe
roadway from the existing gravel sectionto a fully developed pavement section complete with asphalt
pavement, curb andgutter, sidewalk, andadequate drainage facilities.The extents of proposed
improvements are shown in Figure1.The intent of the work is to design the improvements per City of
Cheyenne standards.

2.2.Topographic Survey-A topographic survey of each site willbe completed by a sub consultant.The

the project.
